# EW2: RECYCLABILITY OR REUSABILITY

**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Project types:** Print, Hybrid, Book, Postcard, Packaging, Signage, Exhibit  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 11, SDG 12, SDG 14, SDG 15

## Description
Design solutions include materials or systems that increase the ease and likelihood of recycling and/or reuse of the product and/or its packaging.

## Why it matters
Product and packaging can be reused or recycled.

## Purpose

Recycled content avoids waste temporarily and reduces the need of using virgin natural resources.
